verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Meltano as CLI-first, managing projects, plugins and pipelines through the command line and version-controlled project files. It documents no programmatic API, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. A CLI is an adjacent interface, not an API that matches UI capabilities, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
